title: React 19: ref is just a prop

slides.say: Want a parent to reach an input inside your component? In React nineteen, ref is just a regular prop.
Read ref from props like any other prop, and pass it on to the built-in input.
The parent creates the ref and passes it down. It ends up pointing at the real input, so the parent can focus it.

slides.text: No more forwardRef for new components. It will be deprecated.
slides.say: New function components no longer need forward ref. It will be deprecated and removed in a future version.
